name: Koitore ~Ren-ai Training~
source:
The main character is Yuu, who has just entered a high school. One day, he is forcibly taken to the club room of the love and romance club, and he finally joins them. What they do is to enjoy love and romance based on certain rules. The main purpose of this club is to help the members be able to enjoy communications with other people.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
主人公优刚刚升入高中。一天，他被强行带到恋爱社的活动室，最终加入了社团。他们的活动，是依照特定规则享受恋爱。社团的主要目的，是帮助成员学会享受与他人的交流。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
